CmsPage.pageName: A weekend on the water, without owning a boat
CmsPage.description: Most of us paddle twice a summer. Renting means no roof rack, no garage and no winter storage.

ElectronicText.textData:
{"title":"A weekend on the water, without owning a boat","eyebrow":"Rent, do not buy","author":"The studio","publishedDate":"2026-09-26","minutes":"3","coverImage":"/images/products/shop/gallery/02/travel/canoe-983864/full.jpg","productIds":"RT-1000","excerpt":"Most of us paddle twice a summer. Renting means no roof rack, no garage and no winter storage.","body":"

A canoe is a lovely thing to own for about four days a year. The rest of the time it needs a roof rack, a garage and a plan for the winter. Renting turns that around: you pick a date, pick the days and paddle out.

How renting works here

The canoe is a rental product. On its page you choose a start date, the number of days and the number of people. The price follows the length of the booking, and the order holds a reservation instead of a parcel.

More than canoes

The same product type rents out vehicles, rooms and tools. A store sets it up once and every rental item works the same way: dates, duration, people, price.

"}

CmsPage.pageName: Film is back: shoot, send, print
CmsPage.description: The Nikon FM2 needs no battery for its shutter. Load a roll, take 36 pictures, send the film to the lab.

ElectronicText.textData:
{"title":"Film is back: shoot, send, print","eyebrow":"Analog","author":"The studio","publishedDate":"2026-09-22","minutes":"4","coverImage":"/images/products/shop/gallery/01/tech/cam-retro-analogue-nikon-fm2-film-03/full.jpg","productIds":"CAM-2644,SV-1000,CAM-7000","excerpt":"The Nikon FM2 needs no battery for its shutter. Load a roll, take 36 pictures, send the film to the lab.","body":"

Thirty-six pictures per roll changes how you look. You wait for the light, you check the frame twice and you keep the shot you took.

A camera that outlives its batteries

The FM2 is all metal. Its shutter works without a battery; the battery only runs the light meter. A camera like this is repaired, not replaced.

From the roll to the print

When the roll is full, book the film developing service. It is a service product: it sells next to the camera, in the same bag, and needs no shipping of its own.

  • Film in the bag with the camera
  • Developing booked as a service
  • One checkout, one order
"}

CmsPage.pageName: The desk edit: fewer cables, more focus
CmsPage.description: Three small changes that make a desk calmer, and how a photo becomes a shopping list.

ElectronicText.textData:
{"title":"The desk edit: fewer cables, more focus","eyebrow":"Workspace","author":"The studio","publishedDate":"2026-09-18","minutes":"3","coverImage":"/images/products/shop/gallery/01/tech/laptop-03/full.jpg","productIds":"KB-5569,PR-1000,PH-1001","excerpt":"Three small changes that make a desk calmer, and how a photo becomes a shopping list.","body":"

A calm desk is mostly subtraction. Fewer cables, fewer devices that ask for attention, one keyboard that feels right.

Three small changes

  • A wireless keyboard and mouse: two cables less.
  • The phone face down and out of reach.
  • One notebook for the day, not five tabs.

From a photo to the bag

On the home page, the workspace photo has dots on the products. Select a dot to see the product, or put everything in the bag at once. Products that need a choice first, such as a configurable PC, link to their page.

"}
